prompt:
## Objective
Extract the capture-queue into one module as the first mechanical step of the C4 MemoryProvider seam: queue-path/state-home resolution is currently triplicated and pi_bridge carries a private queue store.

## Design summary
- Create memento/queue.py implementing the EXISTING QueueStore protocol (memento/capture_runtime.py L23; MemoryQueueStore test double at L424 shows the contract). Move into it: state-home resolution (MEMENTO_PI_STATE_HOME / XDG_STATE_HOME fallback, currently at pi_bridge.py L156-159 and duplicated at lifecycle.py L1899-1911), queue-file + legacy-queue-file path resolution (pi_bridge.py L164/L169, lifecycle.py L1915/L1919, health.py L1626), and the _PiQueueStore implementation (pi_bridge.py L2470).
- Consumers delegate: pi_bridge.py, lifecycle.py, and health.py call the new module; their local helpers become thin delegating wrappers or are deleted where private. pi_bridge becomes a consumer of QueueStore, not an owner.
- Behavior freeze: path resolution semantics, file formats, and legacy fallback order must be byte-identical - this is a boundary move, not a redesign (ticket: 'no behavior changes beyond the boundary move'). Write a characterization test first: resolved paths under each env-var combination match current behavior in all three modules.
- Explicitly OUT of scope (design-bearing, deferred): splitting build_session_context (lifecycle.py L2105-2390), the broad-except cleanup, any capture/search behavior. Note them as follow-ups in the final report.

## File scope
Include: new memento/queue.py, memento/capture_runtime.py, memento/pi_bridge.py, memento/lifecycle.py, memento/health.py, tests (test_capture_runtime, test_pi_bridge, test_lifecycle, test_health). Exclude: everything else, especially store.py (separate slice) and triage/search.

## Constraints
Gates via .venv/bin/python. Zero observable behavior change. No remote writes.

## Verification
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_capture_runtime.py tests/test_pi_bridge.py tests/test_lifecycle.py tests/test_health.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check . && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check .
.venv/bin/python -m compileall -q memento hooks scripts
